lines.en: My toes hang half a foot off the ground.
The iron above my head rotates.
I move along the rock wall.
My body sways gently.
I go around a magnet pillar.
I drag iron tools behind me.
I drift half a block per step.

lines.zh: 我沿着磁石的纹路往上飘。
lines.en: I drift up along the lodestone's grain.

lines.zh: 窄缝挡不住我这样的身子。
lines.en: A narrow seam can't stop a body like mine.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂着，指尖有铁屑。
lines.en: My arms hang, iron dust at the fingertips.
I stop on a lodestone.
I leave no footprints and stir no wind.

lines.zh: 我悬在一根磁石柱上方。
lines.en: I hover above a lodestone pillar.
The iron spear above turns slowly.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛映着磁场的蓝光。
lines.en: My eyes reflect the field's blue.
I listen inside the rock.

lines.zh: 磁场让我身边的东西都偏了。
lines.en: The field pulls everything nearby off true.
I line my iron tools up.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，场在替我动。
lines.en: I stay still; the field moves for me.

lines.zh: 我能浮在你头顶一整天。
lines.en: I could hover over your head all day.
I count the iron nearby.
When I turn my head, the iron dust follows.
You carry six pieces of iron.
Every move you make, I feel it.
Your sword is moving.
Don't stand beneath me.
What's above me may fall.
Too close, and the field tangles.
I know this smell of metal.
That iron at your waist is mine.
I lower myself over your head.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在悄悄挪位置。
lines.en: Your armour is quietly shifting.
I drift off some distance.
A piece of my iron fell.
My field broke for an instant.
I steady the field again.
I climb to the cave roof.
My field broke for a moment.
The field holds; I can still push.
The tools spin again.
I pull my iron back.
My iron scatters across the floor.
The iron in your hand — give it to me.
That's made of iron.
I can pull it.
Let go and the iron comes to me.
It's already on my side.
Don't hold on.
Your iron is pure.
I only want iron. Nothing else.
Step back and it will come.
Loosen a little more iron for me.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我飘开了。
lines.en: You hit me and I drifted off.
I have little weight.

lines.zh: 你的铁被我的场抓住了。
lines.en: My field caught your iron.
I retreat upward.
When iron comes near, I feel it.
We bumped and the tools rang.
I tighten the field again.

lines.zh: 你被自己的剑拽了一下。
lines.en: Your own sword tugged you.

lines.zh: 我绕到你抬手够不着的地方。
lines.en: I drift where your arm can't reach.
Stand outside the lodestone ring.
I grew out of a magnetic field.
I don't understand this.
I see only iron.
Put the sword down first.
I drift off a little.
You carry too much iron.
There are few of us.
Leave this vein.
I still have a vein to find.
I turn my field elsewhere.
I reach and pull it in.
Iron comes on its own.
This isn't iron.
I hold it in my field.
It circles above my head.
This iron lies beyond my field.
This iron doesn't belong here.

lines.zh: 这个能挂在我的铁架上。
lines.en: This can hang on my iron frame.
I test its magnetism.
Iron that falls is mine for the taking.

lines.zh: 你腰上的铁在叫我的名字。
lines.en: The iron at your waist calls my name.
I look up and my tools start spinning.

lines.zh: 你的剑尖自己转向我了。
lines.en: Your blade has turned to me on its own.
I counted how many iron pieces you have.
The field is tangled where you stand.
I rise to meet your eye line.
Don't grab anything iron.
My field has caught you.
The iron comes down with me.
This range is enough.
Your sword has already tilted.

lines.zh: 你的剑已经偏向我这边。
lines.en: Your sword is already tilting my way.

lines.zh: 我把铁砂从岩壁上吸起来。
lines.en: I draw iron sand off the wall.
I rose two blocks.
One by one, the iron tools rise.
There's an iron bar behind you.
I wheel around your armour.
Your weapon keeps drifting.
I pull your sword upward.
You can't hold it.
The field favours me.
You've backed to the lodestone.
By the lodestone it's worse for you.
All the iron is on my side.
Raising your arm takes effort.
I add a little more force.
Your arms won't lift.

lines.zh: 我把你手里的铁往上提。
lines.en: I lift the iron in your hand.
Tools spin above your head.

lines.zh: 你退到磁石边，那里更糟。
lines.en: You back to the lodestone. Worse there.
Your wrist is being pulled.
Iron sand creeps along the floor.
You can't lift your arm.
One step back from you is half a foot up for me.
I start turning your sword.
Iron sand wheels around you.
I hurl an iron block.
The spear above drives down.
That one was iron.
I yank your sword into you.
Your own armour snags you.
I push you with the field.
The tools drag you back two steps.
A tool slams by your feet.
I lift another block.
I set the iron down.
I hurl an iron block at you.
The spear above drives down.
I yank your armour.
Your own sword strikes you.
I shove you back with the field.
Iron sand gets in your eyes.
That one carried a whole block.
You are pinned in place.
I slap an iron plate at you.

lines.zh: 你被铁器带得转了一圈。
lines.en: The iron spins you a full turn.
I float up out of the lodestone.
The field here is strong.
My iron appears first.
Iron sand on the walls is stirring.
The field gathers first; then I take shape.
I hear iron ringing.
I gather the scattered iron.
There is a vein here.
I rise off the lodestone.

lines.zh: 我沿着磁石柱一圈圈走。
lines.en: I pace the lodestone pillars in rings.
I wait for someone carrying iron.
I rise on the field.
Fire heats my iron; it is hot.
I fell and the iron landed first.
Water weakens my field.
The blast scatters my iron.
Something struck my iron.
Spell-light fights my field.
I haven't drawn iron in a long time.
Lightning makes my field jump.
My iron is pulled downward.
